header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH KARACHI
Date Order with signature(s) of Judge(s)
body: >>>>>> <<<<<< Record shows that earlier on 08.09.2026 when for the first time instant petition was placed before court, while issuing notices to other side, interim relief was granted to the petitioner. However, learned counsel for the petitioner did not furnish requisite sets of copies and cost for issuance of notices to the respondents, therefore, office has listed instant matter for orders on account of non-prosecution. Today despite repeated calls none has appeared on behalf of the petitioner. In our view non-compliance of court directions is deliberate only to defeat the interest of other side. Accordingly, order dated 08.09.2026 to the extent of interim relief granted to petitioner is recalled.

Office is directed to issue direct notice to petitioner and intimation notice to his counsel for 28.01.2027 with directions to furnish requisite sets of copies and deposit cost for issuance of notices to the respondents. It is clarified that in case of failure to comply with above directions within stipulated period, matter shall be liable to be dealt with in accordance with law, including appropriate orders on account of non-prosecution.
Judge Head of Const. Benches Aamir/PS Judge
